tasks.description: Builds a license inventory of vendored dependencies from their manifests and LICENSE files. Use when asked for a license inventory of a project's dependencies.
tasks.intent: Inventory the licenses of vendored dependencies from local manifests.

tasks.description: Drafts a third-party NOTICE file from the copyright lines and licenses of vendored dependencies. Use when asked to draft a NOTICE file for the vendored dependencies of a project.
tasks.intent: Draft a NOTICE file listing copyright holders and licenses of vendored dependencies.

tasks.description: Flags vendored dependencies whose licenses are denied or need review under the project's license policy. Use when asked for a copyleft or license-policy flag report on a project's dependencies.
tasks.intent: Flag vendored dependencies that conflict with the license policy.
